name: Vertical AI
tagline: Local-first multi-agent AI system. No cloud. No keys. No excuses.
description: Vertical AI is a fully local multi-agent AI system built to run on Android via Termux and Ollama. No paid APIs. No cloud dependency. No data leaving your device. Designed by a solo developer in Wellington, Kansas — it proves that serious AI infrastructure doesn't require a Silicon Valley budget. Includes agent orchestration, local inference, and a modular architecture that can be extended with new agents.
features: Fully local — runs on Android/Termux with Ollama
No API keys, no cloud, no ongoing costs after setup
Modular architecture — add new agents as needed
Proven on real hardware by a solo developer
Privacy-first — all data stays on device
pricing_model: One-time setup and configuration service — custom quote per client
estimated_roi_per_business: Eliminates ongoing cloud AI costs — pays for itself within 1-2 months for active users
